accounts.savemodel: ♥★ save instantly, the rest need Save
accounts.savemodel.tip:
♥ and ★ on a card are written to the database immediately — there is no Save button.
Rating, content type and creator are edited in the [Edit] drawer and need Save.
Bulk edits are the same: pick first, then Apply.
accounts.sel.applynote: Bulk edits need Apply - unlike the card ♥★, which save instantly
accounts.sel.cleared.page: Page changed - selection cleared (no cross-page memory: a selection you cannot see is worse)
accounts.sel.pickfield: Pick what to change first (the dropdowns above are all "-")
accounts.sel.scope.back: Selection changed by hand - scope fell back from "all matching" to "this page"
accounts.sel.warn.1: This goes beyond the current page.
accounts.sel.warn.2: Applying will change {n} accounts you {cannot} see right now.

accounts.sortnote.favorite: Within favorites, sorted by stars then name
accounts.sortnote.last_fetch.asc: Never checked sorts first - those need it most
accounts.sortnote.norecord: Accounts with no record sort last
accounts.untracked.head: Auto-untracked ({n} not-found in a row)
accounts.viewmedia.none: This account has no media on record yet
accounts.viewmedia.tip: Show only this account on the media page

act.rate_limited: Can retry (better to wait a while first)
action.refresh.tip:
Reload this view
(keeps filters and page)
activity.auto.on: on — picks up pending every few seconds
activity.backend.tip:
The backend is not responding.
While it is down, whatever the extension sends will not arrive either.
activity.ext.none: nothing received since the backend started
activity.tip: Three background flows, each independent. Open to see each one.
bulk.stars.tip:
Stars live on the media, so only the ones you picked change.
(Unlike rating, which affects the whole post.)
common.question: {s}?

detail.content.label: Content (untagged)

err.bulk.nothing_to_change: No field was given to change.
err.fetch.host_required: This platform needs a host (for example misskey.io).
err.fetch.upstream_failed: The platform did not answer as expected.
err.file.missing: The original file is gone - deleted, or that drive is not plugged in.
err.file.outside_root: This file is outside the allowed media directories (see extra_media_roots).
err.link.bad_role: That is not a valid role.
err.media.not_downloaded: This one has not finished downloading.
err.retag.no_defaults: This account has no defaults set, so there is nothing to apply.
err.thumb.ffmpeg_missing: Video thumbnails need ffmpeg, and it was not found.
err.thumb.no_frame: No frame could be extracted - the original file may be broken.
err.thumb.queue_timeout: The thumbnail queue is busy; try again in a moment.
err.thumb.render_failed: The thumbnail could not be produced.
err.thumb.ugoira_unreadable: The ugoira archive cannot be opened.
err.thumb.unsupported: No thumbnail can be made for this format.
fetch.clearrate.tip: Once cleared they really run, but they may be rate limited again
fetch.full.tip:
Do not stop at posts already fetched.
Use this to fill gaps in the middle.
fetch.parse.nocred: ⚠ Will fail — {platform} credentials are not set (the settings page shows how)
fetch.parse.nocred.n: {n} lines will fail for missing credentials
fetch.parse.note: Parsing is a preview. Nothing is written.
fetch.paste.tip:
One account URL per line (misskey.io / baraag.net / pixiv).
Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
For other Fediverse sites use misskey|https://site/@someone.
fetch.paste.title: Batch fetch by URL
fetch.pixiv.nocred.note: — no credentials, see the settings page
fetch.pixiv.nocred.tip: pixiv credentials (PHPSESSID) are not set; fetching will definitely fail
fetch.pixiv.tip:
pixiv is throttled hard (1.8 s per request, concurrency 1).
One account can take a long time.
fetch.queue.tip:
The queue lives in memory only — restarting the backend clears it.
Re-running is cheap (incremental); just paste again when needed.
fetch.queue.title: Fetch queue
fetch.queued.n: {n} accounts queued — results appear in the queue below
fetch.refreshall.tip:
Incremental: stops at the first known post, nothing is re-fetched.
Ignored and untracked accounts are skipped; each reason is listed when the run finishes.
fetch.refreshall.title: Refresh all
fetch.resume.n: Resume the {n} that did not finish
fetch.retryvsresume.1: Retry and Resume are two different things.
fetch.retryvsresume.2: Hitting the page limit is not a failure.
fetch.scope.mintime: At least {time}; longer when there is actually something new
fetch.scope.nothing: No account the backend can fetch right now
fileerr.403:
This file is outside the allowed media directories (403).
If you changed the download directory, add the old one to extra_media_roots in config.toml.
fileerr.404:
Cannot read the original file (404) — it was deleted, or that drive is not plugged in.
The path in the database is what was recorded at import time; it has never been re-checked.
fileerr.409: This one has not finished downloading.
fileerr.415: No thumbnail can be made for this format.
fileerr.500: The original file is broken (no thumbnail could be produced).
fileerr.503:
Video thumbnails need ffmpeg, or the thumbnail queue timed out.
The settings page shows the detection result. Images and ugoira are unaffected.
fileerr.ok:
The file reads fine (HTTP 200) but the browser cannot display it.
Possibly an unsupported codec, or an incomplete file.
job.attempt.tip: Expand the reasons for each attempt
job.resume.tip: Continues from the saved cursor, not from page 1
job.retry.anyway.tip: Retrying this reason usually does not help; fix the cause first
job.retry.tip: Puts it at the back of the queue; it does not jump the line

media.more.queue.none: Nothing pending or failed right now
media.more.stars.none: Nothing rated yet — picking one gives 0 results
media.safe.r18off: Safe mode is on, so r18 cannot be picked (switch is top right)

problems.errors.title: Download failures
problems.logs.title: Server logs
problems.requeued.rest: Not downloaded yet — turn on background download, or press Download now.
problems.retryall.tip: Put every failed media back in the queue
problems.title: Problems & logs
queue.clear.none: Nothing has been queued that has not started
queue.empty.1: The queue is empty — nothing has been fetched yet.
queue.empty.2: Paste some URLs, or press Start to run one incremental pass over the tracked accounts.
queue.ratelimited.2: — clearing lets them retry, and they may be limited again.
resume.queued.2: They continue from the saved cursor, not from page 1.
retry.refused.queued: {n} were not queued (already in the queue)
retry.requeued.2: They go to the back of the queue and run in order.
retry.willskip: ⚠ {n} of them belong to sites that are still rate limited and will be skipped.
retry.willskip.2: To make them actually run, tick "Also clear rate-limit flags" and retry.
safe.off.tip:
Off: the media page shows r18 content.
Click to turn safe mode back on.
safe.on.tip:
On: the media page hides posts tagged r18.
This only affects media queries; accounts and fetch are unaffected.
settings.autodl.off: Off — does not fetch by itself
settings.autodl.on: On — picks up pending media by itself
settings.autodl.tip:
When on, it picks up pending media to download every few seconds.

It does not affect the two explicitly triggered paths — they ignore this switch:
· the extension’s "Send and download" (via /api/queue/run)
· "Download after fetch" on the fetch page
settings.autodl.title: Background download
settings.ffmpeg.config: the one you set in config.toml
settings.ffmpeg.path: the one on your system PATH
settings.ffmpeg.tip:
A video cell in the grid says "ffmpeg needed" in words — it is not a broken image or a grey box.
A system ffmpeg, or the optional imageio-ffmpeg dependency, are both detected.
settings.heal.none: No account has been healed yet.
settings.heal.pending: {n} accounts still have only a name.
settings.heal.tip:
Imported accounts usually have only a name, no platform id.
When they are collected the backend fills it in, merging duplicate rows if needed.
settings.heal.title: Account identity healing
settings.heal.warn: ⚠️ The match is by account name, and names get released and re-registered.
settings.heal.warn.b: This is the only place you can trace a mis-attribution.
settings.language.reload: Changing the language reloads the page.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.prefs.broken: The preferences file could not be read; defaults are in use.
settings.prefs.broken.tip:
Anything you changed here will not apply this run; changing it writes a fresh file.

Actual error: {err}
settings.readonly.title: Read-only
settings.readonly.unavailable: Cannot read the settings (the backend did not respond)
settings.restart: Restart after changing these — otherwise one batch of media ends up split across two places.
settings.restart.tip:
These live in config.toml. They are not runtime switches that someone forgot to add.
They decide where files land; swapping them mid-run splits one batch of media across two places.
settings.safe.count: r18 in the library right now:
settings.safe.label: Hide media tagged r18 on the media page
settings.safe.title: Work safe mode
settings.source.env.locked: Set by an environment variable; not editable here.
settings.title: Settings
skip.cannot_fetch.1: The backend has no fetcher for this platform
skip.cannot_fetch.2: X needs the extension to collect
skip.ignored.1: You marked it ignored; you can undo that on the accounts page
skip.ignored.2: Only affects Refresh all. No data was touched.
skip.pixiv_excluded: pixiv was not included this time
sort.label: Sort
src.auto: auto (guessed by machine, not confirmed by a human)
src.manual: manual (by hand, or classified at import — cannot tell them apart yet)
stars.tip: Click a star to rate; click the same one again to clear
verdict.allclear: {n} finished completely, none hit the limit.
verdict.capped: {n} accounts did not finish — they hit the page limit.
verdict.capped.2: Use Resume; running it again will not help.
verdict.capped.tip:
Resume continues from where it stopped.
A normal refresh will not help: incremental stops at the first known post on page 1.
verdict.failed.n: {n} failed — categories and what to do are below.
verdict.head: {n} accounts done · +{posts} posts / {media} media
verdict.historyfull: The queue only keeps the last {n}.
verdict.historyfull.2: Older results are gone; "Retry all" cannot reach them.
verdict.pending: ⚠ {n} media are still not downloaded. Background download is currently {state}.
verdict.pending.auto.on: on, and will pick them up
verdict.samecause: Two failures in a row for the same reason — retrying will not help.
verdict.skipped.tip:
Mostly X accounts that need the extension, or sites that are rate limiting us.
The per-item reasons are in the breakdown below.
verdict.untracked: {n} accounts were auto-untracked this run (repeatedly not found): {names}.
verdict.untracked.2: No data was touched; they are just not fetched automatically any more. You can restore tracking on the accounts page.
